SQL_DOC.P_SQL: UPDATE KEP_GE SET IF_FLAG = 'E', ESTIMATE_PRICE = $UNIT_PRICE$, ESTIMATE_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), ESTIMATE_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') WHERE ADD_DATE = SUBSTR($QUOTATION_NO$,1,8) AND QUOTATION_NO = SUBSTR($QUOTATION_NO$,9,6) AND QUOTATION_SEQ = TRIM($QUOTATION_SEQ$)
